outcome: irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) diagnosis after 18 years of age
finding: While birth weight and neonatal distress were not associated with IBS, mode of delivery was associated with an increased risk for IBS in young adulthood, with vaginal instrumental delivery and Cesarean delivery slightly increasing the odds.
mod_finding: Vaginal instrumental delivery and Cesarean delivery were associated with slightly increased odds of IBS (adjusted OR 1.14 [1.06-1.24] and 1.09 [1.03-1.16] respectively).
